status: RETIRED 2026-09-17 — this file is a pointer, not a config.
why: This was a headless-batch matrix for tuning the economy constants. Every layer of it was dead — PLAN-economy-grid.md §2's autopsy B1-B7, all re-verified 2026-09-17 against source.
B1: the matrix is not in the batch driver's input format ({matrix:{name:[...]}} vs the {axes:[{path,values}]} expandMatrix wants), so it expanded to ONE run, the template verbatim.

B2/B3/B4/B5: the map id, the scenario, the aiId and the AI profile named below do not exist. `scenario` and `modoptions` are not headless-manifest fields at all, so every cell would have fallen through to game_start.lua's six-unit stub force with zero AIs.

B6 is the one that made repair pointless: the economy metrics never reach the stats dump. StatsDump is a fixed 15-field C++ struct with no Lua hook, and velocity/pool-ratio/dead-frames live in a Lua-local inside authority/metrics.lua. tools/economy-validation.js read run.data.economy.teams, a key the engine has never written, so every criterion iterated an empty object and returned true. The grid passed vacuously on ANY dump.
B7d: gsRNG.SetSeed(18655, true) is hard-coded, so the four-seed axis produced four byte-identical runs.

All of that follows from measuring the economy from OUTSIDE the sim. The economy is arithmetic — a cost formula, an escrow ledger, rate EMAs, the generator's caps and rewards — and needs no map, units or pathfinder to exercise. The harness now drives those real modules directly in pure Lua, so the numbers are real, the seed axis is real, and a cell runs in milliseconds instead of hours.
not_covered_by_the_replacement: Whether units can physically reach the objectives, whether strategos spends the way the player model assumes, and whether a map's regions produce the contest the control rule keys on. Those need a live match and always will — see PLAN-economy-grid.md for the headless-parity work (manifest scenario/modoptions/seed fields, the rulesParams snapshot into the dump) that would be needed to measure them.

retired_config.comment: Kept verbatim for provenance only. Do not feed this to anything.
